groups.meta: needs the Pluto to Eris Junction and Archwing

rows.label: The Jordas Precept
rows.note: rewards the Atlas main blueprint and unlocks the Golem node

conditions: Replaying a quest does not re-grant its reward. If the main blueprint is lost or sold, Cephalon Simaris sells a new one for 50,000 standing.

groups.meta: about 2 kills each for Neuroptics and Chassis, about 4 for Systems
conditions: Explosive and grenade Archguns (Ayanga, Arbucep) report near-zero damage on the Golem. Bring a direct-fire, high fire-rate Archgun such as Mausolon, modded for Heat and Slash.
The Golem scales, so a weak build or an uncoordinated squad drags the fight out.
bonuses: The node gives no Mastery XP and is not needed for Eris Steel Path completion.

disclosures.title: the fight
disclosures.body: Take Amesha: it heals you and keeps energy topped up. The one weakpoint is the engines on its back, so circle behind and shoot them, and dodge the gas trail. A fight runs about 5 to 15 minutes with a decent Archgun and 20-plus undergeared; stuck players should run earlier Archwing missions for mods first.

disclosures.title: skip the fight: Circuit week 7
disclosures.body: With The Duviri Paradox done, pick Atlas in week 7 of the 12-week normal Circuit rotation. Tier 2 gives Neuroptics, tier 5 Chassis, tier 8 Systems and tier 10 the main blueprint, all guaranteed in one week. Rewards claim once per week and reset Monday 00:00 UTC.
